centralized_iam_provider_enabled.title: Centralized IAM Provider Enabled
centralized_iam_provider_enabled.description: Indicates whether a centralized identity and access management provider (e.g., LDAP, Active Directory, Okta, AWS IAM Identity Center) is configured and actively enforcing policies across all zones and services.

policy_enforcement_scope.title: Policy Enforcement Scope
policy_enforcement_scope.description: Describes the breadth of centralized policy application across the environment. 'all_zones' means every zone and service is covered; 'partial' means some zones or services are excluded; 'none' means no centralized enforcement exists.

least_privilege_policy_enforced.title: Least-Privilege Policy Enforced Centrally
least_privilege_policy_enforced.description: Indicates whether the centralized IAM system enforces least-privilege access controls for all users and service accounts across every resource location.

automated_lifecycle_management_enabled.title: Automated Identity Lifecycle Management Enabled
automated_lifecycle_management_enabled.description: Indicates whether the centralized IAM system automatically provisions, de-provisions, and updates access rights in response to identity lifecycle events across all zones.

mfa_enforcement_scope.title: MFA Enforcement Scope
mfa_enforcement_scope.description: Indicates which user populations are required to authenticate with MFA. 'all_users' means every user including service accounts, 'privileged_only' means only admin/privileged roles, 'none' means MFA is not enforced.

step_up_authentication_enabled.title: Step-Up Authentication Enabled
step_up_authentication_enabled.description: Whether step-up re-authentication with MFA is required for sensitive or high-risk operations such as privilege escalation, data exports, or configuration changes.

mfa_bypass_mechanisms.title: MFA Bypass Mechanisms
mfa_bypass_mechanisms.description: List of active bypass mechanisms that allow authentication without MFA (e.g., 'trusted_ip_whitelist', 'legacy_auth_protocols', 'remember_device', 'service_account_exemption'). An empty array indicates no bypasses are configured.

rbac_policy_model_enabled.title: RBAC/ABAC Policy Model Enabled
rbac_policy_model_enabled.description: Whether a formal Role-Based Access Control or Attribute-Based Access Control policy model is actively enforced across the environment, as opposed to relying solely on flat permissions or ad-hoc access grants.

least_privilege_scope.title: Least Privilege Permission Scope
least_privilege_scope.description: The granularity level at which permissions are scoped. Indicates whether permissions are assigned at a coarse (broad wildcards or admin-level roles) or fine-grained (specific resource, action, and condition-level) scope.

service_identity_rbac_coverage.title: Service Identity RBAC Coverage
service_identity_rbac_coverage.description: Whether non-human service identities (e.g., service accounts, workload identities, API keys) are subject to the same RBAC/ABAC policy controls as human users, with distinct roles and minimal permission scopes.

credential_rotation_policy_enabled.title: Credential Rotation Policy Enabled
credential_rotation_policy_enabled.description: Indicates whether an automated credential and API key rotation policy is configured and enforced for service accounts.

max_credential_age_days.title: Maximum Credential Age (Days)
max_credential_age_days.description: The maximum allowed age in days for service account credentials or API keys before mandatory rotation or expiry is enforced.

dormant_account_detection_enabled.title: Dormant Account Detection Enabled
dormant_account_detection_enabled.description: Indicates whether automated detection and alerting or deprovisioning of dormant or inactive service accounts is active.

authentication_logging_enabled.title: Authentication Logging Enabled
authentication_logging_enabled.description: Whether comprehensive logging of all authentication attempts (successful and failed) is enabled across all zones.

log_coverage_scope.title: Log Coverage Scope
log_coverage_scope.description: The breadth of events captured in authentication logs: whether coverage includes authentication, authorization decisions, policy changes, and session activities.

tamper_evident_storage_configured.title: Tamper-Evident Log Storage Configured
tamper_evident_storage_configured.description: Whether logs are stored in a tamper-evident or write-once manner (e.g., log integrity validation, immutable storage, cryptographic signing) to support forensic use.

behavioral_analytics_enabled.title: Behavioral Analytics Enabled
behavioral_analytics_enabled.description: Whether the IAM system has behavioral analytics / anomalous access pattern detection actively enabled and processing events.

risk_score_triggers_automated_response.title: Risk Score Triggers Automated Response
risk_score_triggers_automated_response.description: Whether elevated risk scores generated by behavioral analytics are wired to automated response workflows (e.g., step-up authentication, session termination, account lock, SOAR playbook).

detection_signals_configured.title: Configured Detection Signals
detection_signals_configured.description: List of anomaly detection signal types actively configured in the behavioral analytics engine (e.g., 'impossible_travel', 'unusual_access_time', 'abnormal_resource_enumeration', 'new_device', 'credential_stuffing').

federated_protocol_configured.title: Federated Identity Protocol
federated_protocol_configured.description: The federated identity protocol in use across trust zones for cross-zone authentication.

cross_zone_sso_enabled.title: Cross-Zone SSO Enabled
cross_zone_sso_enabled.description: Whether single sign-on is actively enforced across all federated trust zones, preventing credential duplication.

identity_lifecycle_automation.title: Identity Lifecycle Automation
identity_lifecycle_automation.description: Whether automated provisioning and deprovisioning is enforced across zones via SCIM or equivalent protocol.

zones_without_federation_count.title: Zones Without Federation Count
zones_without_federation_count.description: Number of network or security zones that are not covered by the federated identity integration.

access_review_enabled.title: Access Review Enabled
access_review_enabled.description: Whether automated access review and recertification workflows are enabled in the IAM system.

review_schedule_frequency_days.title: Review Schedule Frequency (Days)
review_schedule_frequency_days.description: How frequently in days the automated access review cycle runs. Lower values indicate more frequent reviews.

auto_revocation_on_no_response.title: Automatic Revocation on Non-Response
auto_revocation_on_no_response.description: Whether permissions are automatically revoked when a reviewer fails to certify access within the review deadline.

event_triggered_review_enabled.title: Event-Triggered Review Enabled
event_triggered_review_enabled.description: Whether access reviews are automatically triggered by identity lifecycle events such as role changes, transfers, or privilege escalations.
